tasks.label: kill-port-3000
tasks.command: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "killing $pids"; kill $pids; fi; lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN || true

tasks.label: force-kill-44911
tasks.command: ps -p 44911 -o pid=,ppid=,comm=,args= || true; kill -9 44911 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'after kill'; ps -p 44911 -o pid=,ppid=,comm=,args= || true; lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN || true

tasks.label: kill-parent-next
tasks.command: ps -p 44905 -o pid=,ppid=,comm=,args= || true; kill -9 44905 44911 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; echo 'after kill'; ps -p 44905,44911 -o pid=,ppid=,comm=,args= || true; lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN || true
